$comment: Documentation + validator contract for content/sources/*.json. See CONTENT.md.

source.id: string, unique across all sources, stable forever
source.title: string
source.url: string (empty allowed only for the original-starter set)
source.creator: string

entry.id: string, unique within source, kebab-case, stable forever
entry.title: string
entry.body: string, paraphrased, never verbatim transcript text
entry.timestamp: MM:SS | HH:MM:SS | "" if not from a video
entry.hypnosis: boolean, optional; false marks a non-hypnosis item
entry.notes: string, optional, reviewer-only, never shown in app
